title: Coverage: encrypt policy snapshot cache, redact by role, migrate rows
story: Fix SEC2-002 (high) and coverage medium findings (SEC2-017)
acceptance: src/modules/coverage/service.mjs cacheSnapshot never writes x-pii values (insured/driver names, property addresses, garaging postcodes) in plaintext to policy_snapshots.doc: a test dumps the table via ctx.db and asserts no PII substring
getPolicySnapshot decrypts on read and returns the same object shape as before; node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/coverage/*.test.mjs passes

Existing plaintext policy_snapshots rows are migrated (encrypted in place by an idempotent migration or lazily on read with rewrite); a test seeds a legacy plaintext row and checks it is readable and then stored encrypted
GET coverage/policy routes mask x-pii fields for auditor and integration roles using the same PII_ROLES rule as claims/routes.mjs; test covers each role and tenant_admin sees clear text

Events and logs from coverage still carry ids and codes only; new tests in tests/unit/coverage/snapshot-crypto.test.mjs and redaction.test.mjs; t.todo for SEC2-002 and SEC2-017 in tests/security can be removed by security after this passes
brief: Read src/modules/coverage/service.mjs (cacheSnapshot ~lines 49-59), adapters/mock-pas.mjs (joinPii ~line 99, how it uses encryptPii for coverage_policies.pii) and routes.mjs. Preferred fix: encrypt the whole snapshot document with tctx.crypto (the tenant-bound ctx crypto described in the core-runtime-api addendum; reuse the same encryptPii/decryptPii helper mock-pas uses) before insert into policy_snapshots.doc, store the envelope string, and decrypt in the read path. Keep any columns used for lookup/expiry (policy id, fetchedAt, version) in clear since they are not PII. Handle both formats on read: if the stored value parses as a plaintext JSON object, treat it as legacy, return it, and rewrite encrypted (lazy migration), plus add an optional idempotent migration/sweep run at module init that re-encrypts all legacy rows per tenant using ctx.db only (tenant-bound ctx; no raw/system access). Redaction: find the PII fields via the schema x-pii markers in src/modules/coverage/schema.mjs and mask (e.g. '***') for roles auditor and integration; copy the role set and masking approach from src/modules/claims/routes.mjs rather than inventing one. Also review remaining medium findings for coverage in architecture/security-review-s2.md section 4/5 and fix any not listed. Do not touch tests/security (read-only); write new tests in tests/unit/coverage/ using the existing helpers.mjs and fake-claims.mjs. Pitfalls: Node 22 requires globs not directories for node --test; do not log decrypted values; do not change the snapshot shape consumed by the claim.reported subscriber and evaluateCoverage; do not edit package.json. If a contract is missing something, post a contract-change to the architecture hub and add the smallest compatible change. When done post to the security hub that SEC2-002 and SEC2-017 (coverage part) are fixed.

verdicts.reason: All 5 criteria met; 105 coverage tests pass; encrypted doc, lazy+sweep migration, role masking verified; no new regressions attributable to coverage in e2e/security
